description: Secret, rare and hidden cars from launch-week guides, with a pin on Rockstar's official Leonida map. Positions are estimates read from area names and are marked approximate in each note. Every row names its sources.

map.source: Rockstar Games, "Leonida Map & Cover Art Poster", standard (screen) version, 2,805 x 3,840 px, downloaded from https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/media/artwork-wallpapers on 20 November 2026 and resized to 1,402 x 1,920 px for phones.

cars.title: Twinstripe Vigero
cars.category: Standout: Street Racer (Declasse Vigero ZX Convertible)
cars.area: Key Lento, outside Brian's Lockup on Sunset Dr (south-west Key Lento)
steps: Go to Brian's Lockup on Sunset Dr, south-west Key Lento. The car is parked outside it.
If the roof is up, smash the window to get in. If the roof is down, hop straight in.
It can't be driven until the Clone Key option unlocks, which Game8 says happens during Chapter 3.
cars.notes: You can see it from Chapter 1 but not drive it until Chapter 3, so it is set to Chapter 3. Leonipedia's guide gives the same spot as 'outside a private club' in Key Lento. Pin is approximate: placed on the area label of Rockstar's official map, because the guides give street names the poster doesn't show. Key Lento is a thin island, so treat the pin as 'south-west end of the island'.

cars.source: Game8, "Driveshaft Hustler Locations and Stats" (https://game8.co/games/GTA-6/archives/638576); GTA6Wiki, "Driveshaft Hustler" (https://gta6wiki.eu/vehicles/driveshaft-hustler/); GTAVIMaps, "GTA 6 Rare Cars Locations: Standout Vehicles" (https://gtavimaps.com/guides/rare-cars/). All read 20 November 2026.
cars.title: Driveshaft Hustler
cars.category: Standout: Driveshaft Famous (1932 Vapid Hustler hot rod)
cars.area: Key Lento, front yard of a large house on Dolphin Dr, just east of Jeb's Snack Bar (south-east Key Lento)
steps: Head to Jeb's Snack Bar on Dolphin Dr in south-east Key Lento.
Go to the large house just east of the bar. The Hustler is in its front yard.
cars.notes: Game8 lists it as a fixed spawn and names no tool, so it is set to Chapter 1 (available from the start), but no guide confirms whether it needs a cloned key. In-game text says it belongs to a Key Lento local, Tommy O'Callahan. The other sources repeat Game8, so this is effectively one source. Pin is approximate: placed on the area label of Rockstar's official map, because the guides give street names the poster doesn't show.

cars.source: GTAVIMaps, "GTA 6 Rare Cars Locations: Standout Vehicles" (https://gtavimaps.com/guides/rare-cars/); GTA6Wiki, "Teniente Manana" (https://gta6wiki.eu/vehicles/teniente-manana/). All read 20 November 2026.
cars.title: Teniente Manana
cars.area: Hamlet, warehouse at the M7 Nova Auto Junkyard
steps: Go to the M7 Nova Auto Junkyard in Hamlet.
The Manana is inside a warehouse there. M7 gang members guard the junkyard, so approach carefully.
cars.notes: GTAVIMaps lists it among rare cars you can grab early, so it is set to Chapter 1, but no guide says whether it needs a cloned key. Both pages credit Game8, so this is effectively one source. It shares the junkyard with the Gauntlet Hellfire. Pin is approximate: placed on the area label of Rockstar's official map, because the guides give street names the poster doesn't show.

All read 20 November 2026.
cars.title: Maibatsu '97 Penumbra FF (the green Fast & Furious car)
cars.area: Vespucci Island, Rialto Islands (west of Vice Beach), villa garage near the middle of the island
steps: Drive to Vespucci Island in the Rialto Islands, west of Vice Beach. KeenGamer's route: cross the bridge to Catalan Island, then the next bridge to Vespucci Island, and follow Neptune Circle to the middle of the island.
Find the villa with tall hedges and a white garage door. Jump the hedge and go through the small green door beside the garage.

Tech4Gamers says to open the main garage door rather than the side door. KeenGamer and GTA 6 Notebook say the side door trips an alarm, so switch off the alarm panel on the left wall and use the switch to raise the shutter.
If the car is locked, smash the driver's window, or use the Slim Jim from Chapter 2. Hotwire it with both sticks and drive out.
To keep it, register it. Registration opens in Chapter 2 (Tech4Gamers says $6,750; KeenGamer says you can register it free as your first car for Moses).
cars.notes: Free to take, no mission needed. Rockstar hasn't called it a tribute. The guides disagree on the garage-door steps (see above). Do not open the trunk unless you want a surprise (Tech4Gamers, KeenGamer). Position is the island's label on Rockstar's map; the villa is near the centre.

cars.title: Hauners Rhino
cars.area: Mile Zero Air Station, Goose Key (south part of the base)
steps: Set Mile Zero Air Station as your destination. It is on Goose Key, at the south-west edge of the map.
Get inside by driving through the main gate, or use the Mile Zero Air Station Southeast stunt jump over the perimeter fence.
Head to the southern part of the base, near the large hangars. The Rhinos are parked there and are unlocked, so no key cloner is needed.
Climb in and get away quickly. Stealing it gives an instant 3-star wanted level.
cars.notes: Open from Chapter 1 (Military Times says no special mission is needed). It can't be stored in a standard garage. Stealing one unlocks the 'Challenging Tank' trophy. Pin is approximate: placed on the area label of Rockstar's official map, because the guides give street names the poster doesn't show.

cars.source: Military Times, "How to steal a fighter jet and battle tank in GTA 6" (https://www.militarytimes.com/news/2026/11/19/how-to-steal-a-fighter-jet-and-battle-tank-in-gta-6/); Tech4Gamers, "GTA 6 How to Steal a Fighter Jet: Mile Zero Air Station" (https://gta.tech4gamers.com/gta-6/guides/steal-a-fighter-jet/); GamesFuze, "GTA 6: How to Find Fighter Jet and Tank and Steal Them" (https://gamesfuze.com/guides/gta-6-how-to-find-fighter-jet-and-tank-and-steal-them/); GTA 6 Notebook, "Where are the rare and secret cars in GTA 6?" cars.title: Hauners P-996 Lazer
cars.area: Mile Zero Air Station, Goose Key (north half of the base)
steps: Get into Mile Zero Air Station on Goose Key (main gate, the southeast stunt jump, or by boat to the western side).
Run to a jet parked on the airfield in the northern half of the base.
Press Y to climb in. Jets are not locked.
Taxi onto the runway and take off at once, because the base fights back.
Two military fighters chase you once you're airborne. Stay low and fast and bank hard if you hear a missile lock.
cars.notes: Open from Chapter 1. Entering the cockpit raises your wanted level to five stars (Military Times, Tech4Gamers); GTA 6 Notebook says four. Jet spawns can vary between visits (GamesFuze). Pin is approximate: placed on the area label of Rockstar's official map, because the guides give street names the poster doesn't show.

cars.title: Pegassi Infernus
cars.area: Vice City, Crosstown Police Station car park, level 7
steps: Go to the Crosstown Police Station on NW 9th St in Crosstown. There is a gate at the entrance.
Wait for a cop to leave through the gate, then sneak in without drawing attention.
Climb to level 7 of the car park and find the Infernus.
Use the Clone Key to get in, then drive to the top floor and use the stunt jump to escape the car park.
It has a tracker, so keep your speed up until you've shaken the police, then deliver it to Randy.
cars.notes: Needs the Clone Key (Chapter 3, from 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS'). The street is NW 9th St in Push Square and NE 9th St in GTA 6 Notebook. Pin is approximate: placed on the area label of Rockstar's official map, because the guides give street names the poster doesn't show.

cars.title: Pegassi Vitello
cars.area: Waning Sands, villa on Flamingo Pkwy, east of Belville
steps: Travel to the villa on Flamingo Pkwy in Waning Sands, east of Belville in Leonard County.
Hop the fence. Consider planting explosives on the gate for a quick getaway, but don't detonate yet.
The Vitello is in the garage nearest the house, on the right as you face the entrance.
Use the Clone Key to take it, then detonate the charges (or a rocket launcher) to break out through the gate.
cars.notes: Needs the Clone Key (Chapter 3). GTA 6 Notebook places Waning Sands in 'southern Vinewood Beach'; Push Square and Radio Times say east of Belville, which matches Rockstar's map. Pin is approximate: placed on the area label of Rockstar's official map, because the guides give street names the poster doesn't show.

cars.title: Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire
cars.area: Hamlet, M7 junkyard east of Boone Speedway off Galerina St
steps: Go to the M7-controlled junkyard east of Boone Speedway, off Galerina St in Hamlet (near Kurt's Barber Shop).
Open the gates at the entrance first so you have a quick way out.
Sneak round the right-hand side of the yard, keeping low, to the back of the junkyard.
Use the Clone Key to take the car and drive it to Randy.
cars.notes: Needs the Clone Key (Chapter 3). Push Square says it can be stolen without being noticed. The Teniente Manana is in the same junkyard. Pin is approximate: placed on the area label of Rockstar's official map, because the guides give street names the poster doesn't show.

cars.title: Pegassi Tempesta
cars.area: Vice City, NE 3rd St (random repossession event)
steps: Look for the random event on NE 3rd St, Vice City: the owner is fighting a repossession man beside a tow truck. Push Square saw it around 1 PM.
Threaten the owner to get him out of the way.
Release the Tempesta from the tow truck and drive it to Randy.
cars.notes: This is a random event, not a fixed spot, so it may not be there when you look. Radio Times also lists a cabin driveway near Lake Tallaloko as a place to find it. Pin is approximate: placed on the area label of Rockstar's official map, because the guides give street names the poster doesn't show.

cars.title: Bravado Banshee
cars.area: Capri, outside the Sweetbay Inn on East Buckley Dr
steps: Go to the Sweetbay Inn on East Buckley Dr in Capri. Push Square found the Banshee parked outside late at night, around 3 AM.
Steal it with the Clone Key and drive it to Randy.
cars.notes: Needs the Clone Key (Chapter 3). The time is one player's sighting, not a confirmed schedule. Radio Times also lists the Sunrise Premium Autos dealership on El Joven Blvd in northern Southside, which is not plotted here. Pin is approximate: placed on the area label of Rockstar's official map, because the guides give street names the poster doesn't show.

cars.title: Ascot Paragon
cars.area: Ocean Beach, outside The Banana Hole on Shore Dr
steps: Go to The Banana Hole Main Bar on Shore Dr, Ocean Beach. Push Square found the Paragon parked outside around 6 PM.
Steal it with the Clone Key.
It has a tracker, so drive fast to Randy to avoid police interest.
cars.notes: Needs the Clone Key (Chapter 3). Radio Times also lists a mansion garage in north Belville, reachable through an open window. Ocean Beach pins are nudged slightly apart so they don't overlap. Pin is approximate: placed on the area label of Rockstar's official map, because the guides give street names the poster doesn't show.

cars.title: Piccia Furia
cars.area: Peacock Estates, mansion garage on Palladia Ln (Peacock Bay)
steps: Go to the mansion on Palladia Ln in Peacock Estates.
Skip the gate. Take the path on the left and hop the hedge, so you're between the water and a garage building on your right.
Go through the garage door. The car is inside.
Clone Key it, open the garage shutters, then escape through the gates to Randy.
cars.notes: Needs the Clone Key (Chapter 3). Pin is approximate: placed on the area label of Rockstar's official map, because the guides give street names the poster doesn't show.

cars.title: Pegassi Toros
cars.area: Tequesta Retreat, outside Pegassi Residences on Bayside Dr
steps: Go to the entrance of Pegassi Residences on Bayside Dr, Tequesta Retreat. Push Square found the Toros parked outside in the early evening (about 6:30 PM).
There is some security around, so be careful.
Clone Key it and make a quick getaway to Randy.
cars.notes: Needs the Clone Key (Chapter 3). The Ultimate Edition '95 Grotti Cheetah is in the same building's underground car park. Pin is approximate: placed on the area label of Rockstar's official map, because the guides give street names the poster doesn't show.

cars.title: Pfister Growler
cars.area: Ocean Beach, multi-storey car park on Fig St
steps: Go to the multi-storey car park on Fig St, Ocean Beach. Push Square found the Growler there around 5 PM.
Clone Key it and drive it back to Randy. Push Square had no issues with this one.
cars.notes: Needs the Clone Key (Chapter 3). Pin is approximate: placed on the area label of Rockstar's official map, because the guides give street names the poster doesn't show.

cars.title: Mamba GT
cars.category: Randy's Wish List (added by a mission)
cars.area: Vice Beach, mansion in Leaf Links
steps: This car is added to Randy's list by the mission '¡Dale Mamba!' once you've delivered some of the other cars. Go to the mansion in Leaf Links, Vice Beach.
Hop the fence and keep low. There is a full security detail. Take the path on the right.
The car is behind the building on the right, but you need its key.
Go in through the main building behind the pool, using the Snap Gun on the doors.
The key is in a bowl on a table behind the sofa in the foyer. Take it, get back to the car and escape to Randy.
cars.notes: Push Square says the car has a tracker and handles awkwardly. Needs the Snap Gun (Chapter 3 per GTA 6 Notebook). Pin is approximate: placed on the area label of Rockstar's official map, because the guides give street names the poster doesn't show.

cars.title: Granforma Zorrusso
cars.category: Randy's Wish List (also a story car)
cars.area: Ocean Beach, first floor of the Hathaway Apartments car park
steps: Go to the Hathaway Apartments multi-storey car park and look on the first floor.
Steal it with the Clone Key.
cars.notes: It is the car from the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS' (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy), which also unlocks the Clone Key. Radio Times and GTAVIMaps (citing PowerPyx) agree on the spot. The apartments' district is Ocean Beach per GTAVIMaps. Pin is approximate: placed on the area label of Rockstar's official map, because the guides give street names the poster doesn't show.

cars.title: Invetero Coquette D10
cars.area: Wasman Island, western docks beside a red shipping container
steps: Go to the western docks on Wasman Island and look for a red shipping container.
The Coquette D10 is parked next to it. Steal it with the Clone Key.
cars.notes: Single source: Radio Times (the other sites repeat it). Spelled 'Waxman' by some guides; the map says Wasman Island. Pin is approximate: placed on the area label of Rockstar's official map, because the guides give street names the poster doesn't show.

cars.source: Cultured Vultures, "GTA 6: Where To Find the Truffade Thrax" (https://culturedvultures.com/gta-6-where-to-find-the-truffade-thrax/), 19 Nov 2026; GTAVIMaps, "GTA 6 Rare Cars Locations: Standout Vehicles" (https://gtavimaps.com/guides/rare-cars/). All read 20 November 2026.
cars.title: Truffade Thrax
cars.category: Randy's Wish List (final car on the list)
cars.area: Dalton Island Club, Dalton Island (ferry from Wasman Island)
steps: Deliver every other car on Randy's list first. Randy then calls you about the Thrax.
Take the ferry from Wasman Island to Dalton Island and go to the Dalton Island Club.
Find the big car park near the back of the club and deal with the security guard.
Drive it back to the ferry, around the golf-cart roadblocks, and get back on in time.
On the mainland, outrun the police (it can't be resprayed), then park it in Bayside Drive Garage.
cars.notes: Single source: Cultured Vultures (GTAVIMaps repeats it). It is set to Chapter 3 because Randy's list opens there, but you only get it after finishing the rest of the list, so it's really later. Cultured Vultures says it pays about $18,000. Pin is approximate: placed on the area label of Rockstar's official map, because the guides give street names the poster doesn't show.

cars.title: '82 Canis Crawler
cars.area: Port Gellhorn, Trader's Union on Gellhorn Ave
steps: Go to Trader's Union on Gellhorn Ave, Port Gellhorn.
Hop the wall a little way up from the locked gate and choke the man repairing the car.
Scan the white Crawler with WAiNK to confirm it, then Slim Jim it (you won't be noticed).
Drive through the gates, outrun the gangs and return it to Moses.
cars.notes: Part of Moses's seven Vehicle Drop-Offs in Port Gellhorn (Chapter 2). Finishing all seven gives you Moses's Emperor Sultan. Locations come from Push Square alone (GTA 6 Notebook confirms the seven car names and Chapter 2). This is Moses's first job, 'Daily Driver' per GTA 6 Notebook. Pin is approximate: placed on the area label of Rockstar's official map, because the guides give street names the poster doesn't show.

cars.title: Declasse Yosemite 1500
cars.area: Port Gellhorn, Bastion St
steps: Drive to Bastion St, off Gellhorn Ave, Port Gellhorn.
The Yosemite is being towed. Scan it with WAiNK and the truck drives off.
Shoot the driver or crash into the cab until he stops and gets out.
Release the Yosemite from the tow truck and drive it to Moses.
cars.notes: Part of Moses's seven Vehicle Drop-Offs in Port Gellhorn (Chapter 2). Finishing all seven gives you Moses's Emperor Sultan. Locations come from Push Square alone (GTA 6 Notebook confirms the seven car names and Chapter 2). The car moves with the tow truck, so the pin is only where the job starts. Pin is approximate: placed on the area label of Rockstar's official map, because the guides give street names the poster doesn't show.

cars.title: BF Bandito
cars.area: Buckskin Swamp, north-east part, Kelly County
steps: Drive to the north-eastern part of Buckskin Swamp in Kelly County.
Use an off-road vehicle, or steal a dirt bike nearby.
The Bandito is being driven along a dirt trail, so follow the trail until you catch it.
Scan it with WAiNK, then shoot the driver or call out to lure him out. Steal it and take it to Moses.
cars.notes: Part of Moses's seven Vehicle Drop-Offs in Port Gellhorn (Chapter 2). Finishing all seven gives you Moses's Emperor Sultan. Locations come from Push Square alone (GTA 6 Notebook confirms the seven car names and Chapter 2). It is a moving target, so the pin is only where to start looking. Pin is approximate: placed on the area label of Rockstar's official map, because the guides give street names the poster doesn't show.

(https://gta6notebook.com/vehicles/where-are-the-rare-and-secret-cars-in-gta-6/). All read 20 November 2026.
cars.title: Annis Hellion
cars.area: Port Gellhorn, bungalow on Orchard Ave south of Moses' shop
steps: Go to Orchard Ave, Port Gellhorn, south of Moses' shop. The Hellion is parked outside the bungalow.
A dog guards the area, so throw the football as far as you can to distract it.
Slim Jim the car and hotwire it, then drive north back to Moses.

cars.title: Karin Futo
cars.area: Draper Island, Postal warehouse at the southern tip
steps: Go to the Draper Island docks, north-west of Port Gellhorn, and find the large Postal building at the island's southern tip.
It's high security, with guards wandering. Use the door on the north-western side of the building, nearest the railway tracks.
Go through the office room into the warehouse. The Futo is parked behind the shutters.
Start the engine before opening the shutters, set a waypoint to Moses and escape.

cars.title: Western Nightblade
cars.area: Ambrosia, Final Chapter motorcycle club on Birch St
steps: Go to the Final Chapter motorcycle club on Birch St in Ambrosia, Kelly County.
Climb the ladder on the left of the building to the roof, run across, and climb down inside. A hammer on the roof can take out a guard near the gate.
Open the gate first so you have an exit.
The bike is on the ground floor at the back of the warehouse, watched by a guard. Distract him with a bottle, hotwire the bike and sell it to Moses.
cars.notes: Part of Moses's seven Vehicle Drop-Offs in Port Gellhorn (Chapter 2). Finishing all seven gives you Moses's Emperor Sultan. Locations come from Push Square alone (GTA 6 Notebook confirms the seven car names and Chapter 2). The club is busier or quieter depending on the time of day. Pin is approximate: placed on the area label of Rockstar's official map, because the guides give street names the poster doesn't show.

cars.title: Declasse Vamos
cars.area: Grayson, garage on Rockledge Rd (just east of Grayson)
steps: Go to Rockledge Rd, just east of Grayson in south-west Lummox County. Expect a shootout with the locals.
The Vamos is in a garage locked with a keypad.
Go into the main building to find the code, which is 2727.
Enter 2727 on the garage keypad, take the car and get it to Moses in good condition.

cars.title: '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy
cars.area: Grassrivers, in a garage (Mariana County)
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission 'Thrillbillies'.
Within about one in-game day, a purple icon appears on the map for the garage in Grassrivers.
Go to the garage and take the buggy.
Collecting it starts Wyman's 'Find Cars for Wyman' questline under Map > Exploration.
cars.notes: Ultimate Edition (paid edition) exclusive. Only for Ultimate Edition owners. Wyman's questline rewards five classic rebuilds ('67 Transgressor, '70 Riata, '64 Mamba GT, Reynolds Kit Car, '72 Deviant). Rockstar's image caption calls it the Paradise Garage. Rockstar's map shows a Paradise RV Park in Grassrivers, but no guide I read says they are the same place, so the pin is on the Grassrivers label. Pin is approximate: placed on the area label of Rockstar's official map, because the guides give street names the poster doesn't show.
